name: gauge
title: Gauge
description: A set of radial gauges, each a full ring with a grey track and a coloured arc that fills to show its value. Large numbers sit in the middle with a small label below, and the values animate.
use: A dashboard needs to show a few metrics as compact circular gauges with live values.
avoid: You need precise comparison between many values; circles are harder to read than bars.
a11y: Each gauge exposes role meter with aria values and a label; the arc animation ignores reduced-motion. (keyboard: n-a, labels: good, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: Three donut-shaped rings on a dark background, one blue, one violet and one green. Each has a dark grey track and a coloured arc starting at the top, a big white number centred inside and a small grey label underneath.
behaves: Each coloured arc grows clockwise from the top to match its number, easing over about a second when the value changes. The demo re-rolls the values every 1.4 seconds.
customise: Set value, min, max, size, thickness and start/end angles, plus a getValueText formatter. Colours come from classes on the range and track.
weight: light: Three small SVG rings using a CSS stroke transition; no canvas or internal loop.
demo: CPU, Memory and Disk I/O gauges with changing values like 72, 73 and 50.
issues: Values re-roll on a timer in the demo, so the circles never settle.
polishWhy: Crisp rings and clear numbers; unprompted re-rolling values can distract.
